name: fitn1
text: [curious] Map pe zoom karo... India. Haryana. Rohtak. [excited] Aur yahaan... Forteasia Industrial Township! Ek sau adtees acre. NH-152D sirf das minute. Rohtak-Bhiwani highway sirf paanch minute. Industrial plots, paanch sau se chaar hazaar square yard. Location pasand aayi? Abhi WhatsApp kariye!

name: fitn2
text: Pehle... yahaan sirf khet the. [excited] Ab dekhiye! Gate khada hai. Site office chal raha hai. Roads pe kaam tezi se. Forteasia Industrial Township, Rohtak. Ek baar site zaroor dekhiye!

name: fitn4
text: Ye hai Rohtak ka naya industrial grid. Ek sau adtees acre. Trucks ke liye chaudi internal roads. Bijli, paani, drainage, sab planned. NH-152D sirf das minute. Forteasia Industrial Township. Future yahin ban raha hai.

name: fitn1-beat
prompt: Modern cinematic electronic ad track, 100 BPM, 4/4. Starts with an airy whoosh and soft risers for 6 seconds while a camera zooms down from space, then a punchy drop with deep sub bass, crisp claps and a catchy synth pluck hook, confident and premium, clear downbeats. No vocals.

name: fitn2-beat
prompt: Trending Indian desi hip-hop phonk instrumental, 95 BPM, heavy 808 bass, sharp hi-hat rolls, cowbell phonk melody with a dhol accent. First 3 seconds sparse and quiet, then a hard bass drop at 3 seconds and strong hits every bar for fast transitions. Energetic, viral reel style. No vocals.

name: fitn3-beat
prompt: Viral Instagram reel beat, bouncy upbeat trap pop instrumental at 110 BPM, playful plucks, punchy kick and snare, quick riser into a drop at 2 seconds, fun and catchy, made for fast cuts and meme captions. No vocals.

name: fitn4-beat
prompt: Dark futuristic synthwave cyberpunk instrumental, 105 BPM, pulsing analog bass arpeggio, gated reverb drums, neon glow pads, tension build for 4 seconds then steady driving groove. No vocals.
